statements.t: Accordingly, we expect to recognize approximately $28.0 million of license revenue per quarter.

We recognized $44.9 million of license fee revenue under the Samsung License Agreement during the third quarter of 2026, and, as of September 26, 2026, $227.5 million of the amounts received was recorded as deferred revenue, of which $47.9 million is expected to be recognized within the next 12 months and the remainder through July 2031.

Our patent litigation with Samsung and Micron has been resolved pursuant to the Samsung Agreements and the Micron Agreements, and a significant portion of our near-term revenue and cash flow is now expected to be derived from license fees and net sales pursuant to these agreements.

Beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026, we also expect to recognize license fee revenue under the Micron License Agreement pursuant to its terms with the amount in excess of the grant-date fair value over the $1.0 million of cash received under the Micron Purchase Agreement.
We expect research and development expenses to increase in future periods as we invest to support growth in our products business.

In addition, in connection with the settlement of our patent litigations with Samsung (see “Management’s Discussion and Analysis - Recent Developments” above) and Micron (see Note 10 to the condensed consolidated financial statements), we have incurred and expect to incur legal fees payable to outside counsel retained on a partial contingent fee basis, calculated as a percentage of amounts received under the…

We expect our selling, general and administrative expenses will increase in future periods as we invest to support growth in our products business, expand our customer base, and when, if and as we recognize additional compensation expenses related to the Award and the retention bonuses for our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer approved in November 2026 and described in Note 10 to the condensed…

During the third quarter of 2026, we released $56.5 million of valuation allowance because we concluded it is more likely than not that the related deferred tax assets will be realized from projected taxable income, and we continue to maintain a $23.0 million valuation allowance against deferred tax assets we do not expect to realize.
We will reassess our valuation allowance and estimated annual effective tax rate each quarter as projections change.

Beyond the next 12 months, we expect our principal sources of liquidity to include cash receipts from product sales and the quarterly license fees payable under the Samsung License Agreement and the Micron License Agreement through 2031.

We have elected the optional exemption not to include sales-based royalties in the remaining performance obligation disclosed under Contract Assets and Liabilities below; these royalties will be determined quarterly over the remaining license term through July 2031.
We capitalize incremental costs of obtaining contracts with customers when such costs are expected to be recovered.

In connection with our license agreement with Samsung, we capitalized contingent legal fees that represent incremental costs of obtaining the agreement and are expected to be recovered through the consideration received under the agreement.
When the supplier is also a customer or customer affiliate, we apply the consideration payable to a customer guidance in ASC 606.

Management based this conclusion on all available positive and negative evidence, including cumulative income in recent years and projected future taxable income, and concluded it is more likely than not that these deferred tax assets will be realized.

As of September 26, 2026, we maintained a valuation allowance of $23.0 million, primarily against federal net operating loss carryforwards expected to be utilized against projected 2026 taxable income and foreign tax credits that are not expected to be utilized due to limitation.
We will continue to evaluate the realizability of its deferred tax assets in future periods.

estimates.t: Our critical accounting policies and estimates are discussed in Note 1 to the condensed consolidated financial statements in this report and in the notes to consolidated financial statements in Part II, Item 8 of our Annual Report and in the MD&A in our Annual Report.

estimates.name: ​ — Revenue Recognition — ​ — Intellectual Property License and Royalty Revenue — ​
estimates.t: During the third quarter of 2026, we entered into a five-year patent license agreement under which we granted Samsung Electronics a license to our patent portfolio.

estimates.name: ​
estimates.t: Our intellectual property license and royalty revenue is comprised of licenses which provide Samsung the right to access our portfolio of patents, including patents added to the portfolio during the license term, in exchange for license fees and sales-based royalties.

estimates.name: ​ — Performance Obligations — ​
estimates.t: Our intellectual property license and royalty revenue includes a single performance obligation to provide Samsung with the right to access our patent portfolio, including patents added to the portfolio during the license term, which is satisfied over time.

estimates.name: ​
estimates.t: Royalties are variable consideration based on Samsung’s reported revenue and are recognized in accordance with the sales-based royalty guidance under ASC Topic 606, Revenue from Contracts with Customers , in the calendar quarter to which the royalty relates.

estimates.name: ​ — Variable Consideration — ​
estimates.t: We include variable consideration in the transaction price only to the extent it is probable that a significant reversal of cumulative revenue recognized will not occur when the related matters are resolved.

estimates.name: ​ — Contract Assets and Liabilities — ​
estimates.t: We continually evaluate whether the revenue generating activities and advanced payment arrangements with customers result in the recognition of contract assets or liabilities.

estimates.t: Capitalized contract acquisition costs are amortized on a systematic basis consistent with the transfer of the goods or services to which the costs relate and are evaluated for impairment in accordance with ASC 340-40.

estimates.name: ​
estimates.t: As of September 26, 2026, capitalized contract acquisition costs totaled approximately $32.9 million, consisting of $7.2 million classified as current assets and $25.6 million classified as noncurrent assets in the accompanying condensed consolidated balance sheets.
estimates.effect: Amortization expense related to these costs was approximately $1.8 million for the three and nine months ended September 26, 2026.

estimates.name: Prepaid Vendor Nonrefundable Deposit — ​
estimates.t: Equity instruments issued to suppliers for goods or services are accounted for under ASC 718, Compensation—Stock Compensation.

estimates.name: ​
estimates.t: Advance payments for contractual rights to access supplier products are recorded as prepaid vendor nonrefundable deposit assets and recognized in cost of sales on a straight-line basis over the contract term.
